blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle is set to travel to Macau on Oct. 31 to lead the diocese’s 450th anniversary commemoration. The diocese of Macau, a major hub for Catholic missionaries in East Asia, chooses Tagle to preside over its commemorative Mass at the Macau Forum, according to the report of CBCP News on Tuesday.
